messages.subject: Fixed autoregressive parameters in SETAR/LSTAR
parts:
Dear Matthieu Stigler, 

I was wondering if one can fix the AR parameters within regimes for your SETAR/LSTAR models. For example, in the low regime I have lag =3 with only the 1st and 3rd coefficients having statistically significant p values. Thank you for your time and consideration. 

Sincerely, 
Ernest Marthy

messages.author: 8c45483022d450d5
messages.subject: Re: [tsDyn] Fixed autoregressive parameters in SETAR/LSTAR
parts:
Hi Ernest

Look at the ML and MH arguments in setar: ML,MM,MH: vector of lags for order for ‘low’ (ML) ‘middle’ (MM, only
          useful if nthresh=2) and ‘high’ (MH)regime. Max must be <=m


library(tsDyn)
setar(lynx, M    L=c(1,3), MH=1:3)


unfortunately, it is only available for stera, not lstar.

Best

PS: For ny future question, please provide a reproducible example whenever possible
